+# REA-T015-OGG-REUSE-20261105 — playback-v3 and volume-isolation correction
+
+Owner REA; observed 2026-11-05 JST. PUBLISHED_INTAKE / NOT_CURATED. Existing Draft PR #16. Golden / strict MATCH / READY: NOT_ESTABLISHED.
+
+## Conclusion
+
+Existing host decoder reuse plus audible DLL output was observed. **The v3 WinMM sink fails the independent BGM/voice-volume acceptance gate; do not proceed to DAT integration with this sink.** Successful HkOggSetVolume / waveOutSetVolume return values are not evidence of independent per-voice volume.
+
+Two sequential full decodes each produced 1,007,616 bytes / 251,904 frames of stereo 44,100 Hz signed 16-bit PCM (about 5.7121 seconds): 472 positive reads, then EOF0, clear0. Two DLL output voices were active during the scenario; volume/stop APIs returned0 and final END0 was recorded. This is concurrent output playback, not concurrent decoder contexts.
+
+The user heard added audio, confirmed BGM continued, added audio stopped and the game remained operable, but suspected BGM became quieter. That concern remains part of the result.
+
+## Decoder evidence
+
+[Summary](RUNTIME_SUMMARY.json), [parser](analyze_playback.py), [source hashes](SOURCE_MANIFEST.json), [receipts](SOURCE_RECEIPTS.tsv). Parser re-run exactly reproduced the summary; all 18 local source hashes matched. Raw log: 55,821 bytes / 1,024 events, SHA256 c1fdb8c5b0df39e5f3b6ea9037db647ee8213da23be26a6ccc24bfcde9f0b21f.
+
+Target EXE SHA256 e8dac301050c8e630d7e0ce93aeefd95e641207d9c0576017f62ba46a8767187; DLL SHA256 e7570b677c7f6ec6000b626825de62d62106938fcd47ac5a04c32a01288f3bf6.
+
+Prior cdecl boundary candidates: 0x005D16C0 open(path, caller-owned outer 0x2D0), 0x005D0F70 borrowed info, 0x005D12E0 signed PCM read, 0x005CFE00 clear. This normal-input run adds EOF and actual audio output to the prefix-only probe. It does not certify every ABI/error/thread path. Host FILE/internal allocations remain host-owned; output PCM/voices are DLL-owned.
+
+Read histogram per cycle: 512×224, 1280×1, 2304×67, 4096×180, EOF0×1. Playback positions progressed for both voice IDs. Configured loop flags and position progression are not independent evidence of audible loop-boundary correctness. No v3 PCM content hash/reference-decoder comparison.
+
+[BUILD_RECEIPT.json](BUILD_RECEIPT.json) is preserved historical pre-run evidence; its BUILT_NOT_RUN_IN_GAME wording is superseded only for this scenario. Runtime receipt source_sha256 is the input asset digest, not an aggregate implementation-source hash; implementation identity is SOURCE_MANIFEST.json.
+
+## Volume audit and corrected interpretation
+
+[Sanitized summary](volume_audit/SUMMARY.json), [read-only helper](volume_audit/read_session_volume.c), [silent waveOut test](volume_audit/test_wave_volume.c).
+
+A read-only audit after v3 found the game session master=0.0499885567, mute0, channel volumes1/1. This agrees numerically with the last DLL5% request quantized as floor(0.05×65535)=3276, then 3276/65535≈0.0499885557. Before-volume is unknown: this supports shared attenuation but does not establish an exact before/after change or exclusive causation.
+
+In a separate silent process on the same PC, two waveOut handles initially returned FFFFFFFF. Setting the first to 0CCC0CCC made the second return 0CCC0CCC. Restoring the first saved value returned0; no subsequent GetVolume verified restored state. No audio buffer was submitted. Original game volume was not changed by this separate test. **WaveOut handle volume is not independent in this environment.**
+
+Legacy APIs assign streams to the process-specific default session, and legacy volume calls can affect application-volume state. [Microsoft: Audio Events for Legacy Audio Applications](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/coreaudio/audio-events-for-legacy-audio-applications). Session volume/mute applies to every stream in that session. [Microsoft: Audio Sessions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/coreaudio/audio-sessions). Consulted 2026-11-05. These support the shared-session explanation; the local two-handle test directly demonstrates the independence failure.
+
+## DirectSound candidate: separate synthetic observation
+
+[Silent DirectSound test](volume_audit/test_ds_volume.c) includes the read-only helper. It created its own hidden window, DSSCL_NORMAL device and two software secondary buffers with CTRLVOLUME, filled them with zero PCM, and played both looping. No primary buffer was modified.
+
+Before: buffer volumes0/0, session master1, mute0, channels1/1. After SetVolume(-3000) on the first: buffers -3000/0, session master still1, mute/channel values unchanged. DS_RESULT0 and HRESULT0. This demonstrates independent secondary-buffer control for this separate synthetic process/environment, **not yet inside Vahren.exe**. The result supports a replacement sink candidate; it is not a validated game-integrated fix. The test return code checks buffer values, while session stability is additionally verified from the recorded audit values.
+
+## Prior relationship and remaining work
+
+[Original design](../REPORT.md), [ABI3](../abi3/REPORT.md), [probe-v2](../probe_v2/REPORT.md) remain historical under the same ID. Earlier audio-output/EOF-untested statements are superseded only for this normal-file v3 run. Any interpretation of successful volume calls as per-voice independence is corrected here.
+
+Design B decoder feasibility is strengthened; replace/validate the sink before DAT work. DirectSound secondary buffers have bounded synthetic support; software PCM gain remains another design candidate. Neither is declared implemented/verified in the game by this package.
+
+Remaining: game-integrated volume isolation with before/during/after BGM session measurements, individual voice control, malformed/missing/truncated inputs, concurrent DLL decoders, leaks/handles, cancellation races, long sessions, audible loop boundaries and DAT path/control integration. Failure poison from prior ownership research remains; successful clears do not justify extra clear after failed open.
+
+User-authorized installed-game run, not certified isolated. Owner INDEX supplies ID/VA/filename discovery; formal ledger/REF/dictionary/relations/generated-search adoption remains curator work. Develop/shared dictionaries unchanged. Raw logs, process IDs, private absolute paths, original EXE/DAT/audio and diagnostic implementation/binaries excluded. Only standalone audit/silent-test sources are published.

+"""Read-only parser for the fixed playback-v3 diagnostic sequence.
+Usage: python analyze_playback.py <playback.log> <run.json> <summary.json>
+Raw paths, PID/TID and absolute ticks are deliberately excluded from output.
+"""
+import collections, hashlib, json, re, sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+def analyze(log, receipt):
+    raw = Path(log).read_bytes()
+    events = []
+    for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
+        m = re.fullmatch(r"tick=(\d+) tid=(\d+) event=([A-Z_0-9]+) value=(-?\d+)", line)
+        if not m:
+            raise ValueError("Unrecognized log record")
+        tick, tid, event, value = m.groups()
+        events.append((int(tick), int(tid), event, int(value)))
+    def vals(key):
+        return [e[3] for e in events if e[2] == key]
+    def need(ok, why):
+        if not ok:
+            raise ValueError(why)
+    need(len({e[1] for e in events}) == 1, "Expected one owner thread")
+    need(events[-1][2:] == ("END", 0), "Missing final END")
+    need(vals("PLAYBACK_BEGIN") == [3], "Wrong diagnostic")
+    for key in ("PLAY_FIRST_RESULT", "PLAY_SECOND_RESULT", "VOLUME_RESULT",
+                "STOP_FIRST_RESULT", "STOP_SECOND_RESULT", "PLAYBACK_RESULT"):
+        need(vals(key) == [0], key)
+    for key in ("OPEN_RETURN", "CLEAR_RETURN", "WAVE_OPEN_RESULT",
+                "PREPARE_RESULT", "INITIAL_VOLUME_RESULT", "WRITE_RESULT"):
+        need(vals(key) == [0, 0], key)
+    need(vals("DECODE_EOF") == [1, 1], "Two EOFs required")
+    need(vals("LOOP_REQUEST") == [1, 1], "Loop configuration")
+    need(vals("WAIT_MS") == [3000, 3000, 3000, 2000], "Scenario timing")
+    need(vals("LIVE_VOICES") == [1, 2, 2, 1], "Scenario resources")
+    need(vals("FIRST_HANDLE") == [1] and vals("SECOND_HANDLE") == [2], "Handles")
+    starts = [i for i, e in enumerate(events) if e[2] == "OPEN_BEGIN"]
+    need(len(starts) == 2, "Two open lifecycles")
+    cycles = []
+    for start in starts:
+        end = next(i for i in range(start, len(events)) if events[i][2] == "PCM_BYTES")
+        block = events[start:end+1]
+        reads = [e[3] for e in block if e[2] == "READ_RETURN"]
+        total = block[-1][3]

+# REA-T015-OGG-REUSE-20261105 — playback v4 / DirectSound音量分離の実機追補
+
+- 区分: owner intake、統合担当による正式採録待ち。2026-11-05 JST。
+- 親研究: [初回経路・ABI設計](../REPORT.md)、[bounded decode](../probe_v2/REPORT.md)、[v3可聴出力と共有音量問題](../playback_v3/REPORT.md)。
+- 親commit: 6337820cd5dda49fdec79e650d1c3913114c0238。
+- 本追補は過去の「v4ゲーム内未検証」を限定更新する。製品完成、DAT統合完了、全入力への安全性認定ではない。
+
+## 結論
+
+既存host open/info/read/clearを用いた全PCMデコードと、DLL所有DirectSound secondary bufferによる2音再生・個別音量・順次停止を、指定SHAの隔離ゲームコピーで観測した。最初のvoiceの音量を変更しても、2番目のbufferの音量は変わらず、ゲームの同一音声sessionの前後値も一致した。ユーザーもv4試験中にBGM音量が変わらなかったと報告した。
+
+ただしゲームは起動時から小さいとの報告がある。v4開始前のmaster値は既に0.0499885567で、終了後も同じ。これはv3の最終指定3276/65535と一致し、Windowsに保存されたsession音量が次の起動へ残ることと整合する。v3以前のbaselineは未取得であり、元の正確な値は復元できない。ユーザーへWindows音量ミキサーのゲーム項目だけを普段の音量へ戻すよう案内した。復元完了は未確認。自動的に100%へ変更していない。
+
+Windowsのsession音量設定には永続性があり、次回の同種sessionへ引き継がれる場合がある。[Microsoft Audio Sessions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/coreaudio/audio-sessions)
+
+## 境界・設計変更
+
+host ABIは既存証拠のまま:
+- open VA 0x005D16C0 / RVA 0x001D16C0
+- info VA 0x005D0F70 / RVA 0x001D0F70
+- read VA 0x005D12E0 / RVA 0x001D12E0、signed16LE指定(0,2,1)
+- clear VA 0x005CFE00 / RVA 0x001CFE00
+- DLL側outerはalign16、0x2D0 bytes。2回のdecoder lifecycleは同じouterで逐次実行。DLL側decoderの並列実行を証明しない。
+
+経路: dedicated worker → host open/info/read(EOF)/clear → DLL temporary PCM → DLL-owned DirectSound device → software secondary buffer Lock/copy/Unlock → SetVolume/Play → Stop/Release → device/window解放。
+
+v3のwaveOutSetVolumeは使用しない。v4はDSSCL_NORMAL、DLL所有hidden window、CTRLVOLUME/GLOBALFOCUS/LOCSOFTWAREのsecondary buffersを使用。原作device・manager・primary bufferを借用・変更しない。PCMはUnlock後に作業heapを解放し、再生中のcopyはDirectSoundが所有する。所有worker以外からのcontrolを拒否する既存方針を継承。DLL自体はゲーム終了まで残す。
+
+DirectSoundのSetVolume引数は100分の1dBの減衰値である。[Microsoft SetVolume](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/windows/desktop/ee418150(v=vs.85))
+
+## 実機観測
+
+[機械集計](RUNTIME_SUMMARY.json)、[再解析parser](analyze_playback_v4.py)。raw logはローカルのみ。
+- EXE SHA256: e8dac301050c8e630d7e0ce93aeefd95e641207d9c0576017f62ba46a8767187
+- DLL SHA256: 46316a6f0b645a7ff8bcefdcd9c1abc50b56c2c88faea48d1c93c6fa7fb83bad
+- log SHA256: b9416567cf3700f8a2fe13959193a4a76fbafc313d815bd96cf93b4f8b27244c
+- 56,926 bytes、1,043 events、1 control worker。launcher exit 0。
+- 各cycle: 1,007,616 PCM bytes、251,904 stereo frames、44100 Hz、16bit、正read472回＋EOF0、clear0。
+- DS device/coop/buffer/Lock/Unlock/Play/volume/Stopは記録範囲ですべて成功。
+- live voice数 1→2→2→1。END=0。
+- voice1 cursor bytes: 525672→94884→625848、volume: -1046→-1046→-2602。
+- voice2 cursor bytes: 525672→49020→401820、volume: -1398で一定。
+- statusは各観測5 (PLAYING|LOOPING)。cursor折返しとloop statusを観測したが、継ぎ目の音質を証明する録音はない。
+- session before/after raw logのSHA256はいずれも899e7e29603f513473e79b3378284675c49e67c1030208baa9ab9fba620bb47a。
+- session相関hash一致、master0.0499885567、mute0、左右channel各1、audit errors0、matching session1。
+- session識別hashは相関用の非暗号学的hashであり、セキュリティ上の同一性証明ではない。
+
+v4での追加音可聴性・操作正常を独立した新しい回答で再確認したとは扱わない。v3にはそれらの本人確認があるが、別runの証拠を混ぜない。
+
+## 検証と残件
+
+22個のsource hashと3実行binary hashをruntime receiptと照合。build時5 C suitesとaudit validation(正常＋8拒否)が成功した記録あり。[build receipt](BUILD_RECEIPT.json)のBUILT_NOT_RUN_IN_GAMEはbuild時の履歴を保存したもので、本追補の実機結果より前の状態。
+
+read-only auditは列挙・必須getterの失敗、欠落項目、多session、異常値を失敗扱いにする。wrapperはsession相関とmaster/mute/channel値を前後比較する。前後snapshotは途中の一時的変化を除外しない。
+
+方式Bは、同一SHA・通常OGG1件・短時間という範囲で具体的な実装成立の根拠を得た。v3のWinMM volume方式は採用しない。次の順序:
+1. ユーザー側の通常音量を復元し、そのbaselineを記録する。診断の再実行は音量復元確認の代わりにしない。
+2. 通常音量で可聴性・BGM/WAV共存を再確認。別OGG、反復、長時間、メモリ/handle収支、device lossを検証。
+3. malformed/truncated/chained-format/failed-openとcodec共有状態のgateを継続。
+4. 既存routine busの固定通知＋VM文字列snapshot/owned queue設計を実装・検証。任意pathを現在のroutine引数へ直接渡せるとはしない。
+5. 製品統合と関数辞書正式採録は別工程。
+
+原作EXE/DAT/音声、raw logs、PID/TID、session識別値、私用path、製品sourceは保存していない。develop・共有辞書は変更しない。

+"""Summarize a playback-v4 run without exporting private paths, PID/TID or session IDs.
+Usage: python analyze_playback_v4.py LOG RECEIPT SESSION_BEFORE SESSION_AFTER OUTPUT
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib,json,re,sys
+
+def digest(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+def analyze(log,receipt,before,after):
+    raw=Path(log).read_bytes()
+    events=[]
+    for line in raw.decode("utf-8-sig").splitlines():
+        m=re.fullmatch(r"tick=(\d+) tid=(\d+) event=([A-Z_0-9]+) value=(-?\d+)",line)

+| Path | Native evidence | Diagnostic policy |
+|---|---|---|
+| fopen fails | 5D16D9 test;5D16DD EAX=-1;5D16E4 ret; no context construction | Poison conservatively; do not issue extra clear |
+| Initial header failure | 5D1584 negative branch;5D1587 datasource=0;5D158D clear | Inner heap/state cleanup performed before wrapper closes FILE |
+| Seekable metadata preparation failure | 5D1689 call5D1310;5D1692 tests;5D1695 datasource=0;5D169B clear | Same ownership split |

+| clear's close guard | 5CFEDF tests datasource;5CFEE3 callback;5CFEEE indirect call | Zeroing datasource suppresses inner file close |
+
+Normal initial preparation publishes state1 at5D1609; that makes the unexpected-state branch unusual, not a license to ignore it under all failures/allocators/corruption. Allocation-failure resilience and all indirect callback behavior are not certified.
+
+Do not issue speculative extra clear after failed open. Diagnostic DLL remains poisoned and requires process exit, retaining the pre-existing conservative policy. A successful open receives exactly one clear; second diagnostic attempt is a fresh open/read/clear lifecycle, not double-clear.
+
+## New-context probe
+
+Two sequential lifecycles on DLL-owned aligned0x2D0 context, maximum16 reads of4096 bytes per lifecycle, signed results and format checked; full outer zero checked after clear without a manual memset between attempts. PCM byte counts, format and FNV1a fingerprints must match between attempts. FNV1a is a reproducibility signal, not a cryptographic proof of audio correctness.
+
+Worker entry is exported stdcall thread procedure; host codec boundaries use explicit cdecl pointers. Original game path and asset path are bound in local settings to the newly supplied OGG test copy. No game execution was performed by the agent while preparing these files.
+
+Launcher refuses other process names, mismatched architectures and an already-loaded diagnostic module. Wrapper additionally requires exact target path and game/DLL/runner/asset SHA256. DLL validates host file SHA256 and four boundary prologues. A new remote thread calls LoadLibraryW, followed by the diagnostic export; module remains loaded until game exit. These operations occur only when user runs Run-Probe.cmd.

+Sixty-second launcher waits bound waiting, not native function execution time. Timeout does not kill threads, unload the module or free still-referenced remote arguments. Do not retry in the same process after a timeout. Windows UCRT/host CRT TLS interaction on the new thread is an empirical test condition, not established by normal BGM-worker observations.

+# HakushinOgg — DAT OGG playback candidate
+
+Status: implemented candidate; real DAT-to-plugin acceptance remains pending.
+Product base: HakushinExtensions f5f89aaaf82ba9a46ea2d4f2cf17b30a482e5d4e.
+Research: REA-T015-OGG-REUSE-20261105, knowledge-base c366e743e5a0571cba4266dedf5621ec5884ca84.
+The earlier playback-v4 diagnostic proved the native decoder + separate DirectSound route in the original process. It did not test this Core plugin or its DAT adapter.
+The user subsequently restored their usual Windows game volume; the reported low startup volume is no longer an open blocker.
+
+## Architecture
+
+```text
+DAT routine(hk_ogg_v1)
+ -> existing selector routine bus (original routine still executes)
+ -> receive: validate VM/thread, copy bounded numeric/path values, return handle
+ -> fixed owned FIFO (32)
+ -> dedicated audio worker
+ -> source path/file guard
+ -> original open -> info -> read until EOF -> clear
+ -> DLL-owned DirectSound secondary buffer (up to 8 voices)
+ -> poll / volume / stop / natural completion
+```
+
+No decode in DllMain or DAT callback. No VM pointers survive the callback.
+This is method B: original decoder, DLL-owned output and lifetime.
+Method A still requires the original WAV manager/ownership ABI and a PCM insertion route; it is not used.
+Method C (independent decoder) is a fallback for other EXE versions or unresolved native decoder behavior.
+
+## Native boundary
+
+Only SHA256 `e8dac301050c8e630d7e0ce93aeefd95e641207d9c0576017f62ba46a8767187` is accepted.
+RVA is relative to the actual loaded module, not an assumed fixed base.
+
+| Operation | RVA / preferred VA | x86 cdecl contract |
+|---|---|---|
+| open | 1D16C0 / 005D16C0 | int(const char *ACP_path, void *outer) |
+| info | 1D0F70 / 005D0F70 | const int *(void *outer, int link), link=-1 |
+| read | 1D12E0 / 005D12E0 | int(void *, char *, int capacity, int bigendian, int word, int signed, int *section) |
+| clear | 1CFE00 / 005CFE00 | int(void *outer) |
+
+The DLL owns a zeroed, 16-byte aligned 0x2D0 outer context; host allocations/FILE are released only through host clear after a successful open. Failed open poisons the service: cleanup is not guessed, and restart is required. Successful open is cleared exactly once, including decode failure/cancellation. Negative decode returns, format changes, invalid counts and partial frames are rejected. Format: signed 16-bit little-endian PCM, 1–2 channels, 8000–192000 Hz. info[1]=channels, info[2]=rate. read flags=0,2,1.
+
+All native/DirectSound operations run serially on one DLL worker; the original BGM can run concurrently as in the earlier diagnostic. Broader concurrency, malformed-stream and device-loss coverage remain incomplete.
+Internal header/init helpers 005D44C0/005D57C0/005D5BD0 are not public entry points and are never called directly here.
+
+DirectSound uses its own hidden window, DSSCL_NORMAL, secondary buffers with per-buffer volume. The DLL never sets primary/session/WinMM volume. Volume is 0–100 percent amplitude mapped to DirectSound attenuation. Stop releases only the selected owned buffer. Loop repeats the whole decoded PCM; gapless Vorbis metadata loops are not implemented.
+
+## DAT contract
+
+Install the authored `dat/HakushinOgg_v1.dat` into the game's script directory. The selector routine bus must already be active. Subscription alone does not prove producer installation.
+Example (literal-path parser acceptance is part of the pending game test):
+
+```text
+routine(hk_ogg_setup)
+setv(@hk_ogg_path,a_default/voice/line.ogg)
+set(hk_ogg_volume,40)
+set(hk_ogg_loop,0)
+routine(hk_ogg_play)
+set(my_voice,hk_ogg_voice)
+// Later, in another event:
+set(hk_ogg_voice,my_voice)
+routine(hk_ogg_poll)
+// Or routine(hk_ogg_stop), routine(hk_ogg_volume), routine(hk_ogg_stop_all).
+```
+
+Do not spin waiting in DAT. Poll in a later event/frame after the worker can run.
+The wrappers reset result=-103 before notification so a missing bus cannot look like an earlier success.
+The path array must have exactly one element, max 1023 bytes in the game ACP, no embedded NUL.
+The main VM must be base+4BE2F0 with the checked evaluator relation at +504.
+Numeric map +4C4 and string-array map +1E8B40 follow the existing EXP implementation; MSVC strings use size+16/capacity+20, inline capacity<16, and array elements stride28.
+
+| Variable | Meaning |
+|---|---|
+| hk_ogg_op | 1 play, 2 stop, 3 volume, 4 stop-all, 5 poll |
+| hk_ogg_voice | positive handle returned for play; input for controls/poll |
+| hk_ogg_volume | 0–100, per added voice |
+| hk_ogg_loop | 0 or 1, at play time |
+| hk_ogg_result | immediate request result; zero means accepted, not audible |
+| hk_ogg_state | 1 queued, 2 playing, 3 ended, 4 stopped, 5 failed |
+| hk_ogg_error | asynchronous backend error |
+
+Handles are monotonically allocated positive 31-bit IDs, never reused in a process. Terminal slots may be reused; a previous handle then returns -102.
+Multiple calls copy their paths immediately; changing DAT variables afterward cannot change an already queued command.
+Controls are FIFO, including stop-all. Stopping during a decode waits for that bounded decode; it is not a preemptive voice cancellation.
+Game exit is the supported DLL update/unload boundary. A clean Core shutdown first rejects new work, wakes/cancels and joins the worker, then unsubscribes/closes handles. Failed rollback retains the Core-owned subscription and pinned module, rather than unloading executing code.
+
+## Bounds and errors
+
+- 8 voice slots, 32 commands, source file <=16 MiB, decoded PCM <=16 MiB per voice.
+- Maximum 64 MiB counted PCM allocations, including the temporary 16 MiB staging allocation and the new DirectSound copy during transfer. This is not a total process/codec/driver memory limit.
+- Relative local-drive paths confined to the canonical game root; rejects parent traversal, absolute/UNC/device paths, ADS, unsafe components and lossy ACP conversion. A read handle remains open through host decoding to exclude ordinary writers/deletion.
+- Full-file decode before playback; short effects/voices are intended. No streaming/cache, automatic WAV substitution, or resampling.
+- -100 invalid argument, -101 capacity, -102 stale ID, -103 not ready/no callback, -104 path/source rejection, -105 VM shape, -106 transient lock busy.
+- Backend: -10 not initialized, -11 wrong thread, -12 argument/resource, -13 host identity, -14 opt-in, -15 failed open (restart), -16 format, -17 memory/PCM cap, -18 decode, -19 DirectSound, -20 native voice cap, -21 poisoned/cleanup (restart), -22 shutdown cancellation.
+- Trusted game assets only. The old native decoder is not a security boundary for hostile OGG data. A native call that never returns cannot be interrupted safely; no forced thread termination is attempted.
+- Device loss is reported. Automatic device recovery is not implemented.
+

+# Explicit audio formats and automatic discovery
+
+> Current bounded acceptance and corrections: [OGG_EXPLICIT_FORMAT_RUNTIME.md](OGG_EXPLICIT_FORMAT_RUNTIME.md). Earlier pending-state passages below are historical snapshots, not the final release status.
+
+2026-11-06. Approved behavior plus read-only native design evidence. Implementation is in progress; native runtime acceptance of this extension remains pending. Isolated component tests do not establish game acceptance.
+
+## Approved selection policy
+
+| Existing command argument | Required behavior |
+|---|---|
+| `foo` | Use WAV if available; otherwise use the same-stem OGG. |
+| `foo.wav` | Use WAV if available; otherwise use the same-stem OGG. |
+| `foo.ogg` | Use OGG only, even when a same-stem WAV exists. |
+
+Same-stem WAV and OGG may contain different audio. Explicit OGG must remain independently selectable; it is not an alias for a WAV-first logical stem. Preserve unrelated filenames and distinguish the format in native cache keys. Discovery must work from the distribution's files without requiring a manually authored manifest; an automatically built immutable catalog can retain the existing bounded lookup and ownership model.
+
+For SE, the conservative builder decision preserves the original WAV root search first: primary WAV, fallback WAV, then primary OGG, fallback OGG. Explicit OGG searches only OGG in primary/fallback order. This deliberately lets a fallback WAV beat a primary OGG for extensionless/explicit-WAV requests, preserving existing native WAV selection. It differs from trying both formats in each root before moving to the next root.
+
+For basename voice requests, existing WAVs across the native voice directories must retain priority for extensionless/explicit-WAV requests. Only when no matching WAV exists should the virtual index select a corresponding OGG. Explicit OGG has a separate selection namespace. Preserve the native outer directory order and first-wins rule within each eligible format; do not let an early virtual OGG conceal a later physical WAV. Directory-derived gains must correspond to the selected audio directory.
+
+## Commands and source identity
+
+The canonical registered DAT command is `playSE`: exact string at `006315E8`, loaded by `004A099F`, assigned opcode `21` at `004A09B4`. VM `004A1250` case 21 uses the normal engine sound route. The single voice command is `vc`: string `006317E8`, registration `004A1190..004A11B9`, opcode 4B. Examples for documentation/tests should use `playSE(foo.ogg)` and `vc(foo.ogg)` with actual available stems.
+
+A read-only scan of the current permitted test-copy DAT files found canonical `playSE` and some lowercase `playse` occurrences, plus the authored `vc` acceptance event. That textual inventory does not establish support for every casing variant. No `playSe` or `se(...)` spelling was established by this audit. Do not rename or add unrelated commands as part of audio format support.
+
+EXE SHA256: `e8dac301050c8e630d7e0ce93aeefd95e641207d9c0576017f62ba46a8767187`.
+Read-only V9 SHA256: `2629cb2f03ecec9927e89892c77f847e4cdba381ab718825c1ca8cfeeef00ede`.
+Addresses are preferred VAs at base `00400000`; use RVA plus actual module base.
+
+## Native suffix construction
+
+All three loaders blindly append `.wav`; none of these sites detects an existing extension:
+
+| Purpose | CALL VA and original bytes | Target / contract |
+|---|---|---|
+| SE `sound/` + argument + `.wav` | `004C09EB`: `E8 60 63 F4 FF` | `00406D50`, cdecl null-terminated list of strings |
+| SE root resolution | `004C09F1`: `E8 9A 67 F6 FF` | `00427190`, cdecl one string |
+| SINGLE volume key | `004C02B4`: `E8 37 6A F4 FF` | `00406CF0`, first string in ECX, suffix on caller-cleaned stack |
+| SINGLE path-index key | `004C037C`: `E8 6F 69 F4 FF` | same custom helper |
+| BATTLE volume key | `004C05A7`: `E8 44 67 F4 FF` | same custom helper |
+| BATTLE path-index key | `004C075E`: `E8 8D 65 F4 FF` | same custom helper |
+| SINGLE indexed directory + name + suffix | `004C0405`: `E8 46 69 F4 FF` | `00406D50`, cdecl |
+| SINGLE primary + `voice/` + name + suffix | `004C043B`: `E8 10 69 F4 FF` | `00406D50`, cdecl |
+| BATTLE indexed directory + name + suffix | `004C07C5`: `E8 86 65 F4 FF` | `00406D50`, cdecl |
+| BATTLE primary + `voice/` + name + suffix | `004C07FB`: `E8 50 65 F4 FF` | `00406D50`, cdecl |
+
+SE uses primary prefix `0068B370` and fallback `0068B38C`. Native `00427190` checks the primary WAV and rebuilds the fallback path on a miss; it does not check fallback existence before returning. SINGLE/BATTLE instead use the startup filename-to-directory map, or primary prefix + `voice/` when that map misses. They do not call the two-root resolver.
+
+Consequently, `foo.ogg` reaches the unmodified factory as `foo.ogg.wav`, and `foo.wav` as `foo.wav.wav`. A bounded adapter can remove exactly the one engine-appended terminal `.wav` when it follows an explicit `.ogg` or `.wav`, preserving the preceding format intent. Repeated unrestricted suffix stripping would change legitimate dotted filenames.
+
+Factory correction alone is insufficient for a basename voice: the preceding path and gain lookups ask for `foo.ogg.wav` or `foo.wav.wav`, so the ordinary `foo.wav` index entry does not match. One design compatible with existing Win32 enumeration hooks is to synthesize explicit-format index aliases in addition to the ordinary entry, allowing native code to build both indexes. These aliases must obey the selection policy above and must not collide silently with real filenames such as `foo.wav.wav`. Test collisions and preserve an explicit, deterministic rule; do not assume aliases are unique.
+
+The helper `00406CF0` is not a standard plain-C ABI. Do not introduce guessed calls to it or to the native C++ map lookup helpers. Existing standard cdecl resolver and stdcall factory boundaries remain preferred adapter points.
+
+## Cache identity
+
+SE `004C0050` and BATTLE `004C04E0` use the original command argument as their cache key. Keep `foo`, `foo.wav`, and `foo.ogg` distinct when their selection semantics can differ. Normalizing all three to `foo` before cache lookup can replay a previously cached WAV for an explicit OGG request. Test both request orders with different WAV/OGG content. SINGLE replaces its current slot, but should obey the same format selection contract.
+
+## Embedded text voice markers also need support
+
+`00434CC0` parses a text/voice form, searches for `.wav`, requires that match to end at the voice-string boundary, strips four characters, then calls SINGLE. Merely enabling `.ogg` in the suffix check would still strip its format intent and incorrectly permit WAV preference.
+
+Two existing CALLs have independently checked standard stack contracts:
+
+- `00434D4D`: `E8 3E 17 FF FF` -> `00426490`, stdcall `(string_object, pattern, length)`, return index or -1, `ret 0C`. The caller tests index+4 == string length at `00434D57..00434D5E`.
+- `00434D8D`: `E8 0E B4 08 00` -> `004C01A0`, stdcall `(manager, voice_name, category)`, `ret 0C`. The intervening substring helper removes exactly the four-character suffix; avoid calling that custom helper from new code.
+
+The isolated `hakushin_ogg_text_voice.h` pair of adapters recognizes terminal OGG, retains a bounded owned copy in state owned by the captured UI thread, lets the existing substring operation run, and restores the explicit name only at the paired SINGLE forwarding call when the trimmed name matches exactly. Each UI-thread find clears old pending intent; each UI-thread SINGLE consumes it before forwarding, including on mismatch. Other threads pass through without touching that state. The forwarded name has a call-local copy so reentry cannot overwrite it. Native string objects are not modified; the existing WAV find behavior is forwarded unchanged. Its tests passed x86 O0 and O2 with warnings treated as errors; game acceptance remains pending.
+
+The embedded delimiter is `@`: parser `00425A20` checks byte `40` at `00425AB9`, ignoring DBCS trail bytes. `00425B6D..00425B7A` extracts the suffix after `@` into output string +1C, while `00425B83..00425BB4` extracts the display prefix. `00434CC0` checks the second string for a voice suffix. The structural form is therefore `display text@voice.wav` / `display text@voice.ogg`. Its verified callers are `00476144`, `004D8B0B`, and `004D8D61`; a specific DAT `msg(...)` acceptance route has not been established by these references, so do not equate this marker form with an arbitrary command argument without runtime or registration evidence.
+
+Acceptance must cover SE, direct `vc`, battle voice definitions, and embedded text markers with extensionless/WAV/OGG inputs as applicable; different same-stem audio; both cache orders; original directory gains; native duplicate directory precedence; Japanese/CP932 names; mixed and OGG-only roots; real double-extension filename collisions; missing assets; and unchanged BGM and unrelated commands. Do not silently narrow the requested feature to `vc` alone.

+## What changed after the failed full migration
+
+The first bridge returned OGG-backed original-device buffers from three original factory CALLs. It also adapted the SE root resolver and used an explicit mapping file. That design passed a small mapped subset while physical WAVs remained available.
+
+Removing all original WAVs exposed an earlier dependency. Native startup enumerates `*.wav` and builds both a filename-to-directory map and a filename-to-additive-gain map. A basename battle request whose index entry disappeared fell back to the primary root's `voice/` directory, losing its original subdirectory. The factory therefore received a different path from the exact mapped key. The failed run's filenames were not logged: this path explanation is supported by static control flow, not direct capture of those particular arguments.
+
+Adding manifest aliases at the factory would have repaired only path lookup. The gain lookup happens before the factory and also depends on the missing startup index. The repair instead supplies virtual WAV enumeration entries to the original startup routine, allowing native code to rebuild both maps with its own allocator, insertion policy and directory settings.
+
+The final extension removes the manual-map dependency. A bounded immutable inventory discovers eligible WAV/OGG files, supplies format-specific index names, and leaves the original outer directory order intact. Selection happens at the existing resolver/factory boundaries, after the native cache-key decision.
+
+## Final selection algorithm
+
+The registered SE command is `playSE`; the registered direct voice command is `vc`. This report does not establish arbitrary casing variants or introduce new command names.
+
+| Command argument | Final intended selection |
+|---|---|
+| `sample` | Native caller appends `.wav`; existing WAV wins, otherwise same-stem OGG may be selected. |
+| `sample.wav` | Existing WAV wins; only absence permits same-stem OGG. |
+| `sample.ogg` | OGG only, even when a same-stem WAV exists. Missing/failed OGG does not fall back to WAV. |
+
+All three original loaders append `.wav` without recognizing an existing extension. The scoped selector therefore removes exactly one known appended suffix: `sample.ogg.wav` becomes `sample.ogg`, and `sample.wav.wav` becomes `sample.wav`. It does not repeatedly strip suffixes. Extensionless input is outside this helper's contract because native construction already appends the suffix.
+
+Paths are decoded with the applicable Windows code page before extension, separator or case decisions. The selector returns an owned bounded copy and one of INVALID, NATIVE_WAV or OGG. It rejects traversal, absolute paths, malformed components, unsupported extensions and overlong input. CP932 trail bytes resembling a slash or an ASCII letter are not treated as separators or case-folded bytes.
+
+For WAV selection, any present WAV is a precedence barrier. Access/sharing and other non-missing attribute errors also remain native; only file-not-found/path-not-found permits format fallback. Failure to read or decode a selected WAV is not a reason to try OGG. OGG fallback probes use the rooted regular-file validation path. Explicit OGG remains an OGG selection even if the eventual open fails, so its failure is reported without playing a WAV instead.
+
+SE preserves the original WAV search across both roots before considering OGG:
+
+1. Primary WAV.
+2. Fallback WAV.
+3. Primary same-stem OGG, only if neither WAV exists.
+4. Fallback same-stem OGG.
+
+Explicit OGG checks only primary OGG then fallback OGG. With no match, the selected fallback path retains the appropriate native-WAV or explicit-OGG failure behavior. In particular, a fallback WAV beats a primary OGG for a legacy or explicit-WAV request.
+
+The SE resolver stores the selected path and selection kind in UI-owned state. A matching route-3 factory consumes that decision once, avoiding a second suffix normalization. An unmatched factory input is selected normally and clears the pending decision. This matters for legitimate compound filenames. The original command arguments remain the native SE/BATTLE cache keys: `sample`, `sample.wav` and `sample.ogg` are not collapsed before cache lookup.
+
+## Automatic voice inventory, aliases and collision policy
+
+Only the reviewed startup inner `*.wav` search is virtualized. The first-call wrapper requires the exact return RVA `B81A9`, active bridge state, loading state 1, a validated voice-directory pattern and a directory resolved inside the game root. The original outer directory enumeration is unchanged.
+
+The inventory scans immediate voice subdirectories, retains native ordering, and considers WAV presence across the sibling directories before allowing a legacy OGG alias. Consequently an earlier OGG cannot conceal a later WAV under the same ordinary basename. Within each eligible format, original first-wins directory precedence remains in force. The native code associates the selected entry with that directory's gain.
+
+For ordinary names, a physical WAV retains its native entry and gains an explicit-WAV key. An OGG gains an explicit-OGG key; if no corresponding WAV exists across the relevant siblings, it also gains legacy and explicit-WAV fallback keys. These are synthetic enumeration names, not files written to disk. Ordinary physical entries precede supplemental entries, with the reserved-key exception below.
+
+Compound names require an explicit namespace rule. Native keys ending in `.ogg.wav` or `.wav.wav` represent format-qualified requests under the new grammar. Exposing a physical `sample.ogg.wav` directly under that raw key could steal an explicit `sample.ogg` request from a different directory, giving both the wrong path and the wrong gain.

+- Such physical compound WAV entries are hidden under their raw reserved keys, but remain in the inventory and receive an appended full-filename alias. For example, the physical `sample.ogg.wav` is reachable through the key `sample.ogg.wav.wav`, generated when the caller requests its full filename.
+- An OGG whose stem itself ends in `.ogg` or `.wav` receives only its explicit full-OGG alias. Ambiguous legacy/explicit-WAV fallback aliases are not emitted for that compound stem.
+- Nonreserved physical names retain their native precedence. Collision tests model native first-wins insertion and verify the selected directory/gain identity, not just an enumeration count.
+
+This deliberately reserves format-qualified index names; it is not an unrestricted basename guessing rule. A future extension must retain this policy or define and test a replacement before changing it.
+
+Enumeration handles are real unique kernel handles owned by the component, not magic pointer values. Each context owns its real underlying search, if any; end-of-list does not destroy the context before Close. Unowned Next/Close handles pass to the captured original APIs with native LastError behavior. Synthetic end reports `ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES`. Synthetic `WIN32_FIND_DATAA` is zeroed except for a normal-file attribute and the filename. Static inspection established that the targeted loop reads only the directory attribute bit and `cFileName`; it does not open the enumerated file or consume its size, times or alternate name.

+Limits are 16 live enumeration contexts, 8 cached voice roots, 32,768 inventoried files and a 32 MiB inventory budget. Inventory errors/cap violations fail the affected context rather than silently dropping names. Failed inventory-close handles remain owned for retry; destruction cannot claim a clean state while such handles remain. The inventory is immutable for the process lifetime; changing voice files requires a new game process.

+|---|---|---|---|---|
+| SINGLE buffer factory | `C046E` | `E8 DD 09 00 00` | `C0E50` | Three stack arguments: manager, path, flag; stdcall-compatible `ret 0C`; returned Buffer8 in EAX. |
+| BATTLE buffer factory | `C082F` | `E8 1C 06 00 00` | `C0E50` | Same factory contract. |
+| SE buffer factory | `C0B81` | `E8 CA 02 00 00` | `C0E50` | Same factory contract. |
+| SE root resolver | `C09F1` | `E8 9A 67 F6 FF` | `27190` | cdecl, one path argument; caller cleanup; returned string pointer. |
+| Embedded-text suffix find | `34D4D` | `E8 3E 17 FF FF` | `26490` | stdcall, string object/pattern/length; index or -1; `ret 0C`. |
+| Embedded-text SINGLE forwarding | `34D8D` | `E8 0E B4 08 00` | `C01A0` | stdcall, manager/name/category; `ret 0C`; caller does not consume a return value. |

+|---|---|---|
+| FindFirstFileA | `209178` | Scope first calls to the audited startup return address and voice folder. |
+| FindNextFileA | `209170` | Intercept owned enumeration handles only. |
+| FindClose | `209174` | Close owned contexts; delegate all other handles. |

Find clears old intent; SINGLE consumes intent before forwarding, including on mismatch/reentry. Other threads pass through without touching UI state. Native string objects are never modified. The copy callback validates the known 16-byte inline union plus length/capacity fields, reads only the bounded string and terminator, and rejects embedded NULs.

+## Decoder, buffer and request ownership
+
+Native decoding stays on the existing single audio worker. The factory caller receives owned PCM and creates a stopped buffer on the original manager's borrowed DirectSound device. It uses `DSBCAPS_CTRLVOLUME`, copies both Lock regions, Unlocks, queries Buffer8 and releases the temporary base interface. Exactly one Buffer8 reference transfers to the original caller. The bridge does not Play, set category volume, Stop or independently release a successfully transferred original-manager buffer. Native duplicate pools, cache ownership and later playback/release remain intact.
+
+The synchronous request owns its copied path, manual-reset completion event, result and references. At most one request is queued/in flight/uncollected. Caller completion wait is clamped to 5,000 ms. Timeout cancels and releases the caller's reference while an active worker retains valid storage until Finish; queued unclaimed work can be removed immediately. Shutdown rejects admission and wakes pending callers. There is no TerminateThread and no retained caller-stack/output pointer.
+
+The PCM block reserves 16 MiB, even for a smaller decoded clip. The budget checks existing DAT-owned voice buffers plus the staging allocation and prospective output copy against 64 MiB. The UI's `bridge_in_call` guard remains set through original-buffer construction and PCM free; the worker does not start another DAT command while that transferred allocation remains live. A DAT command admitted just before the guard changes completes on the same worker before bridge decoding starts. On timeout, no PCM transfers to the caller, and the worker finishes/frees its owned result before processing another decode.
+
+These limits are not a cap on total game memory: original-manager cached buffers and native index nodes belong to the engine; inventory has its separate budget. The 5-second completion wait is not a 5-second end-to-end latency guarantee, and it does not forcibly interrupt a blocked native call. Cancellation is cooperative between decode operations.

+Successful native opens are cleared once after decoding. An ambiguous open failure poisons further native reuse rather than speculatively invoking cleanup; a failed clear also poisons the backend. Such states require process exit and retained code lifetime. Native source handles remain open through decode to exclude ordinary concurrent modification/deletion. Unsupported format changes, malformed reads, cancellation and budget failures return failure without publishing a partial buffer.
+
+The source validator requires a local disk file resolved inside the game root, an OggS signature and a source size from 4 bytes through 16 MiB. Decode accepts mono/stereo signed-16 PCM at 8,000–192,000 Hz, rejects incompatible format changes, and enforces the separate 16 MiB decoded-PCM cap. The latter branch does not use fallback prefix `0068B38C`.

+Thus an ordinary basename becomes `<primary>voice/<basename>.wav`, losing its subdirectory. It no longer matches an exact manifest key for `<primary>voice/<subdirectory>/<basename>.wav`. SINGLE `vc` with a subdirectory already included in its argument can still work, explaining the observed difference without invoking a thread mismatch.

+Volume is computed before the factory call. Battle `004C05A7` forms the filename plus `.wav`; `004C05E9` selects manager+9C; `004C05FB`, `E8 00 0C 00 00`, calls `004C1200`. A hit contributes the node's signed DWORD at +28; a miss contributes zero. Native code then combines that value with `default_btl` and the manager's category setting and clamps it before SetVolume. SINGLE's analogous per-file lookup is `004C0304`, `E8 F7 0E 00 00`. Both lookup sites use EAX map / EDI string / stack output-node / `ret 4`; ordinary category lookups are separate calls.

+The permitted local sound settings contain directory gains: small0=200, small1=400, small2=800, small3=1200, small4=1600. Only these factual numeric settings are recorded here, not the original DAT content. Explicit filename aliases in the bridge manifest would repair routing but would not restore these native gain contributions. Correcting gain after buffer construction would also conflict with the original caller's subsequent SetVolume.

+## Duplicate filenames
+
+Path insertion is first-wins. In `00439E00`, the duplicate branch at `00439F39` destroys the newly allocated candidate, `00439F49` returns the existing node, and `00439F4B` sets the insertion flag to zero. It does not replace the existing directory prefix.
+
+A read-only call to the actual FindFirstFileA/FindNextFileA APIs over the permitted copy's outer voice directory scan returned small3 before small4 (ordinals 6 and 7 including dot entries). Therefore those two directories preserve small3 as the first path candidate for their shared filename. The implementation owner separately reported that the duplicate source WAV contents match; equal audio content alone is not semantic equivalence because the directory gains differ. Retaining the original outer directory enumeration is preferable to inventing a duplicate policy.
+
+## Scoped virtual WAV enumeration contract
+
+The proposed repair virtualizes only the inner WAV filename scan. Its first-call wrapper checks the exact caller return RVA `B81A9`; unrelated first calls forward unchanged. Next and Close wrappers act only on their own tracked enumeration handles. All three wrappers use the ordinary Win32 WINAPI ABI; no custom native lookup call is required.
+
+| API | IAT VA / RVA | Inner CALL VA and original bytes | Return VA / RVA |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| FindFirstFileA | `00609178` / `209178` | `004B81A3`: `FF 15 78 91 60 00` | `004B81A9` / `B81A9` |
+| FindNextFileA | `00609170` / `209170` | `004B848E`: `FF 15 70 91 60 00` | `004B8494` / `B8494` |
+| FindClose | `00609174` / `209174` | `004B84AE`: `FF 15 74 91 60 00` | `004B84B4` / `B84B4` |
+
+The PE import table identifies all three as KERNEL32 imports. They are six-byte indirect calls: use managed IAT pointer patches, not the existing five-byte relative CALL mechanism. Validate the expected original API pointers and retain the same exact-host and early-bootstrap gate used by the bridge. Partial patch recovery must retain the wrappers and their state while any installed pointer can still reach them.
+
+The complete inner loop `004B81C0..004B8481` uses only:
+
+- `dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY` to skip directories (`004B81C0` tests bit 10h).
+- `cFileName`, copied into native strings used to populate the two indexes.
+
+It does not consume file size, timestamps, alternate filename, or file contents, and does not open the enumerated voice file. Its calls are string operations, map allocation/insertion/lookups, and allocation cleanup. Virtual entries can therefore provide an exact ACP WAV filename with the directory bit clear; unused metadata can be initialized to zero.
+
+The inner find handle is stored at stack+2C. FindNextFileA is called until false and FindClose follows once. A failed first call also reaches FindClose(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE), which should retain native passthrough behavior. Keep virtual handle state alive after end-of-enumeration until Close; support an early Close without leaking the real underlying enumeration.
+
+The outer directory scan must remain unchanged: its Next call is `004B8105` / return `004B810B`, and Close is `004B8115` / return `004B811B`. This retains the game's directory order, first-wins resolution, and the native association between each directory and its sound setting.
+
+Recommended merge policy within each requested directory: return original WAV results unchanged first, then explicit manifest WAV entries missing from that real enumeration. Match the immediate parent directory only, not recursive descendants; suppress real/virtual duplicates using the existing pathname encoding and comparison rules. Keep the manifest immutable for every live enumeration. Do not globally alter FindFirstFileA behavior or synthesize arbitrary unlisted basenames.
+
+## Validation still required
+
+This is static support for the repair, not proof that the new enumeration implementation works. Focused tests should cover absent WAVs, mixed real/virtual entries, duplicate suppression, exact caller restriction, unrelated/outer handles, independent enumeration positions, end-of-list lifetime, early Close, empty results, failure cleanup, and partial IAT-install rollback/retention.
